'''Trellen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], at the junction of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Trellen Trade Route/Legends|Trellen Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. A part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] since at least [[17,000 BBY]], [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, Trellen served as a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] as well as a stronghold of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] [[Battle of Trellen|attacked]] Trellen as part of their [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|emergence]] from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].

==Description==
Trellen was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Trellen system/Legends|Trellen system]]. It lay in the [[Arrowhead]] region, a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Trellen was situated between the [[Mawan system/Legends|Mawan]] and [[Ruul system/Legends|Ruul systems]] on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. It was also located at the endpoint of the [[Trellen Trade Route/Legends|Trellen Trade Route]], which linked it to the [[Humbarine system/Legends|Humbarine system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Trellen10ABY-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|310px|Trellen was attacked by the Galactic Empire in 10 ABY.]]
Trellen fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as early as [[17,000 BBY]], and during the early [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of wars that began in [[17,018 BBY]] and saw the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies struggle over [[Politics/Legends|political]] and economic control over the Republic, Trellen was affiliated with Coruscant.<ref name="EGTW" />

Between [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Trellen was a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but by [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], it had instead become a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] stronghold. A [[Battle of Trellen|battle]] was fought at Trellen in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] as part of a [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|concentrated attack]] on New Republic holdings by [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] emerging from hiding in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], after which the Imperial [[Operation Shadow Hand|offensive]] [[Battle of Balmorra|continued]] onto the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trellen was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA" />
